verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair axis for a managed data-pipeline platform, but the evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging, or test environment isolated from production data. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: the Connector SDK coding-agent skills mention "test" without any isolated environment, the MCP server can copy connections to a new destination (a user-side workaround), and the MCP read-only scope is an access control, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
